featured.title: Nepal Flood Death Toll Surges Past 330 as Glacier Collapse Scale Becomes Clear
featured.excerpt: Scientists confirm an ice-rock avalanche, not an earthquake, triggered one of Nepal's worst natural disasters, with over 900 people still missing including dozens of Americans and 177 Indian pilgrims.
featured.image_caption: An aerial view shows houses buried under mud and debris following flash floods in Nepal on August 26, 2026. The floods killed over 330 people and left more than 900 missing across eight districts.
featured.nri_angle: 177 Indian pilgrims en route to Kailash Mansarovar are among the missing, 63 Americans unaccounted for, and downstream flooding prompted evacuations in Bihar — the disaster has direct implications for diaspora families across South Asia.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

editorial.title: Mirzapur: The Movie — Critics Say Pankaj Tripathi and Ali Fazal Deliver a Thrilling Return to the Underworld
editorial.excerpt: Critics are largely positive about the film, praising its engaging narrative and performances despite some concerns over its length.
editorial.nri_angle: The film is available with subtitles, making it accessible for non-Hindi speakers in the diaspora. Fans of the series will find it a satisfying continuation of the story.
editorial.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Onslaught — Critics Say Adam Wingard's Latest is a Mixed Bag of Action and Horror
just_in.excerpt: The film receives mixed reviews, with some praising its nostalgic elements while others criticize its execution.
just_in.image_caption: 'Onslaught' directed by Adam Wingard, now in theaters.
just_in.nri_angle: As an English-language film, it is easily accessible for diaspora audiences. However, its reliance on genre tropes may not resonate with everyone.

just_in.title: WhatsApp Launches Bill Payments in India, Connecting 500 Million Users to 22,700 Billers
just_in.excerpt: Meta's messaging platform integrates Bharat Connect network for utility, insurance, and loan payments directly in-app.
just_in.image_caption: The WhatsApp logo on a green background. The messaging platform launched bill payments in India on September 3, connecting users to over 22,700 billers through the Bharat Connect network.
just_in.nri_angle: NRIs can remotely manage and pay utility bills for family in India directly through WhatsApp, simplifying cross-border household support.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Squash Momo: The Himalayan Dumpling Making Delhi Queue Up at CR Park
just_in.excerpt: Limbu Kitchen in Chittaranjan Park has drawn long lines for its iskus momo, a chayote squash-stuffed dumpling rooted in eastern Nepal's culinary traditions.
just_in.image_caption: Squash momos at Limbu Kitchen in Delhi's Chittaranjan Park have drawn long queues. The Himalayan dumplings use a seasonal squash filling wrapped in traditional dough.
just_in.nri_angle: Chayote squash is widely available at Indian and Hispanic grocery stores in the U.S., making iskus momo an easy Himalayan dish for diaspora cooks to recreate at home.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: 13 Percent of Indian Employees Face High Burnout as AI Threatens 20 Percent Job Cuts
just_in.excerpt: A Great Place To Work India study of 5.7 million employees finds persistent burnout, declining discretionary effort, and growing anxiety over AI-driven workforce reductions.
just_in.image_caption: Around 13 percent of Indian employees report high-level burnout, according to Great Place To Work India, as AI-driven restructuring threatens up to 20 percent of jobs.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian diaspora professionals in the U.S. and globally face similar pressures around AI adoption, burnout and shifting workplace expectations.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Adobe Acquires Indian AI Startup Rilo in Second India Deal After Rephrase.ai
just_in.excerpt: The IIT Bombay-founded marketing automation startup raised $1 million at a $10 million valuation before being acquired less than a year after launch.
just_in.image_caption: Adobe has acquired Rilo, an Indian AI marketing automation startup founded by IIT Bombay alumni, in a licensing and team acquisition deal.
just_in.nri_angle: The acquisition of an IIT Bombay-founded startup highlights India's growing role as a source of AI talent and technology for global tech giants.

just_in.excerpt: The province's last capped-sector intake of the year offers employers in retail, trucking, accommodation, and food services a narrow window on September 14-15 to nominate foreign workers for permanent residence.
just_in.image_caption: Saskatchewan has allocated 550 permanent residence nomination spots across four sectors for its final intake of 2026, opening September 14-15.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian workers in Saskatchewan's retail, trucking, and food services sectors face a critical deadline to secure permanent residence nominations before the year's final intake closes.

just_in.title: Sony Sets November 6 Global Release for Ramayana With Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi
just_in.excerpt: The first Indian film to receive the 'Filmed for IMAX' label will get a worldwide theatrical release from Sony Pictures, timed to coincide with Diwali festivities.
just_in.image_caption: Ranbir Kapoor stars as Lord Ram in Ramayana: Part One, set for a worldwide release on November 6, 2026 through Sony Pictures.
just_in.nri_angle: Sony's global distribution marks the first time a Hollywood studio has given a mainstream worldwide theatrical release to an Indian film, with diaspora audiences expected to drive significant turnout alongside crossover appeal.

just_in.title: Toxic English Version Hits Indian Screens Today With Tighter 18-Minute Shorter Cut
just_in.excerpt: The English version of Yash's pan-India gangster drama arrives in Indian cinemas on September 4 with a leaner runtime, even as the film's box office trajectory remains a talking point after a sharp post-opening decline.
just_in.image_caption: Yash stars in Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups, whose English version releases in Indian cinemas on September 4 with an 18-minute shorter cut.
just_in.nri_angle: Lionsgate acquired international English distribution rights to target non-diaspora audiences in western theatrical chains, while Phars Film handles the five Indian-language versions overseas.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: CLARITY Act Explained: What the US Crypto Bill Means for Indian Investors
just_in.excerpt: The landmark digital asset legislation heads to a Senate floor vote on September 15, establishing a regulatory framework that could reshape how Indian investors approach cryptocurrency markets.
just_in.image_caption: The CLARITY Act faces a Senate cloture vote on September 15 as lawmakers return from recess. The bill would establish the first comprehensive US framework for digital asset regulation.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian investors in US crypto markets stand to benefit from clearer asset classification and compliance rules, while India's own regulatory approach — built on a 30% flat tax and mandatory AML registration — differs fundamentally from the US framework.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: How a WhatsApp Group of 500 Engineers Is Guiding Nepal's Desperate Tunnel Rescue
just_in.excerpt: A messaging group set up before the August 26 disaster has become an unlikely lifeline, sharing tunnel blueprints and worker locations as rescue teams search for hundreds still missing.
just_in.image_caption: A WhatsApp group of over 500 engineers is providing tunnel layouts and access drawings to rescue workers at six devastated hydropower sites in Nepal.
just_in.nri_angle: India is among the countries assisting Nepal's rescue operations, and the disaster highlights infrastructure vulnerabilities across South Asia's growing hydropower sector.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: India-US Trade Deal Awaits Preferential Tariff Framework, Says Piyush Goyal
just_in.excerpt: Commerce Minister says negotiations on the first tranche are closed but India will not finalize until Washington guarantees a tariff edge over Vietnam, Bangladesh, and other competitors.
just_in.image_caption: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said India has closed negotiations on the first tranche of the India-US trade deal but awaits a preferential tariff framework from Washington.
just_in.nri_angle: Trade deal outcome directly affects Indian exporters and NRI business interests; preferential tariffs could boost sectors employing millions across India.

just_in.title: Sensex Gains 362 Points as Fed's Waller Signals Pause, but Weekly Losses Mount
just_in.excerpt: Indian benchmarks snap a four-session losing streak after Fed Governor Christopher Waller's dovish comments, though crude oil concerns and Middle East tensions cap gains.
just_in.image_caption: The BSE Sensex closed 362 points higher on September 4, snapping a four-session losing streak after Fed Governor Waller signaled a rate pause.
just_in.nri_angle: Fed rate decisions directly affect NRI investment flows and remittance values; FCNR deposit surge shows diaspora capital playing a growing role in India's forex stability.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: That Silver Coating on Your Mithai May Be Aluminium, and Doctors Say It Can Harm Your Liver
just_in.excerpt: Cheap aluminium foil is increasingly being substituted for genuine silver leaf on Indian sweets, with health experts warning of risks to the liver, kidneys, and nervous system from accumulated heavy metals.
just_in.image_caption: Silver-coated Indian sweets. Regulators have found that some silver foil on mithai may actually be aluminium, which doctors warn can harm the liver.
just_in.nri_angle: NRIs sending or receiving Indian sweets during festivals should be aware of aluminium-adulteration risks in silver leaf, particularly when buying from unverified sources.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: ISRO Targets Gaganyaan Uncrewed Launch by Late 2026 as Space Calendar Fills Up
just_in.excerpt: India's first uncrewed orbital test flight of the Gaganyaan programme, carrying the Vyommitra half-humanoid robot, is targeted for Q4 2026 after a National Review Committee clearance in May.
just_in.image_caption: An illustration of ISRO's Gaganyaan spacecraft, India's first human spaceflight program.
just_in.nri_angle: The Gaganyaan programme aims to make India the fourth nation to independently launch humans into space, a milestone closely watched by the global Indian diaspora.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

news.nri_angle: India faces below-normal rainfall that threatens sugar and rice crops, while rising global food prices affect household costs for diaspora families sending remittances and for consumers worldwide.

news.title: India Drops Pre-Defined OBC Lists From Census 2027, Reigniting Caste Data Debate
news.excerpt: The government will use open-ended caste entries instead of administrative OBC classifications, drawing fierce criticism from opposition parties who warn of a repeat of the unusable 2011 data.
news.image_caption: India's government has dropped pre-defined OBC lists from Census 2027, opting instead for open-ended text entries for caste enumeration.
news.nri_angle: Census caste data shapes reservation policies that affect educational admissions and government employment for Indian citizens and those maintaining ties to India's social systems.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Publicis Wins PepsiCo's $5.4 Billion Media Account, Exits Coca-Cola Pitch
news.excerpt: The French agency group displaces Omnicom as PepsiCo's lead global media partner in a deal covering 200-plus markets, and withdraws from rival Coca-Cola's ongoing review.
news.image_caption: PepsiCo's global headquarters in Purchase, New York. The company awarded its 5.4 billion dollar media account to Publicis Groupe, which exited the competing Coca-Cola pitch to secure the deal.
news.nri_angle: Publicis already handled PepsiCo's media in India and several Asian markets; the global consolidation puts Indian advertising professionals at the center of a unified 200-market operation.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Delhi Court Grants Bail to AAP's Satyendar Jain in Jal Board Corruption Case
news.excerpt: The former Delhi water minister was ordered to furnish a personal bond of Rs 2 lakh after spending over two weeks in judicial custody on charges of manipulating sewage treatment plant tenders.
news.image_caption: Satyendar Jain, the AAP leader, was granted bail by a Delhi court in a Jal Board corruption case.
news.nri_angle: The case adds to the string of legal battles facing AAP leaders, a party that drew significant NRI support during its anti-corruption campaigns.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Canada Probes Import Risks After India Raid Uncovers Fake Labels on Food Products
news.excerpt: The Canadian Food Inspection Agency is the first foreign regulator to respond after Indian authorities seized nearly $80,000 worth of relabelled PepsiCo, Nestle and Coca-Cola products from a Mumbai warehouse.
news.image_caption: Food safety authorities inspect product labels at a facility. Canadian regulators are investigating import risks after Indian agencies uncovered fake labels on food products meant for export.
news.nri_angle: The incident raises safety concerns for Indian diaspora communities in Canada who regularly purchase imported Indian food products.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Telangana CM Sacks Minister Konda Surekha From Cabinet Over Party Indiscipline
news.excerpt: Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy removed the Forest and Environment minister after Congress high command backed disciplinary action triggered by her daughter's public attacks on party leadership.
news.image_caption: Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy, who dismissed minister Konda Surekha from his cabinet over party indiscipline.
news.nri_angle: The internal Congress turmoil in Telangana is closely watched by NRIs from the state who maintain strong ties to regional politics.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Posts 7.8% GDP Growth in Q1, but Data Debate Clouds the Numbers
news.excerpt: India's April-June growth comfortably beat forecasts, driven by an investment surge and manufacturing strength, but critics question whether a base-year revision inflated the headline figure.
news.image_caption: The North Block in New Delhi houses India's Ministry of Finance. India reported 7.8 percent GDP growth in the first quarter, though economists questioned the methodology behind the numbers.
news.nri_angle: India's GDP credibility debate affects NRI equity investments, rupee-denominated assets, and global capital allocation to Indian markets.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Google Escapes Ad Tech Breakup as Judge Rejects DOJ Forced Sale
news.excerpt: Federal judge opts for behavioral remedies over structural separation, marking the third consecutive failure by U.S. antitrust enforcers to break up a major tech company.
news.image_caption: The Googleplex, Google's corporate headquarters in Mountain View, California. A federal judge rejected the DOJ's demand that Google sell off its ad technology business.
news.nri_angle: The ruling affects the broader tech industry where many Indian-origin professionals work, and has implications for digital advertising costs that impact Indian-American small business owners.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Modi Demands End to Terror Double Standards at SCO Summit in Bishkek
news.excerpt: At the 26th SCO Summit in Kyrgyzstan, PM Modi called for dismantling the entire ecosystem of terrorism while sharing warm exchanges with Xi Jinping and Putin — as Pakistan's Sharif stood by without interaction.
news.image_caption: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi at the SCO Summit. Modi called on member states to end double standards on terrorism and pushed for greater counter-terror cooperation.
news.nri_angle: India's anti-terrorism stance and frozen India-Pakistan ties directly affect diaspora communities through visa policies, security postures, and bilateral relations.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Both Parents' Vitamin B12 Levels Linked to Birth Defect Risk, Major Study Finds
news.excerpt: A large prospective study from China shows that higher B12 in fathers — not just mothers — before conception is associated with fewer birth defects, a finding with outsized implications for India's B12-deficient population.
news.image_caption: An expectant couple during pregnancy. A large prospective study found that higher vitamin B12 levels in both parents before conception are linked to a lower risk of birth defects.
news.nri_angle: Vitamin B12 deficiency affects an estimated 40–75% of India's population, making these findings directly relevant to Indian families planning pregnancies — especially those on vegetarian diets.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Centre Defers Manipur Census Amid Protests Over NRC and Ethnic Tensions
news.excerpt: The September 1 house-listing exercise was put on hold after Amit Shah chaired a review and civil-society groups demanded an NRC update first.
news.nri_angle: Diaspora members from Manipur face continued uncertainty as institutional governance stalls in the state.

news.excerpt: Suspected militants opened fire on a Kuki-inhabited village in Kangpokpi, killing three and critically injuring four.

nri-world.title: Pawan Kalyan Turns 55: How Martial Arts Built a Deputy Chief Minister's Discipline
nri-world.excerpt: The Telugu star-turned-politician marked his 55th birthday on September 2, capping a year in which he became the first Telugu person inducted into Japan's Takeda Shingen Clan while governing four ministries in Andhra Pradesh.
nri-world.image_caption: Pawan Kalyan, the Telugu actor and Deputy Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh, turned 55 on September 2, 2026.
nri-world.nri_angle: Pawan Kalyan's massive Telugu diaspora fanbase follows his political and cinematic career closely, and his martial-arts discipline resonates with NRI audiences interested in wellness and cultural pride.

nri-world.title: Nepal's First Woman Helicopter Captain Flies 100 Rescue Missions in Under a Week
nri-world.excerpt: Captain Priya Adhikari, 40, has been flying nearly continuously over Nepal's flood-ravaged Rasuwa district, pulling survivors from mudslides that have killed more than 1,000 people across Nepal and Tibet.
nri-world.image_caption: Captain Priya Adhikari, Nepal's first woman helicopter captain. The 40-year-old pilot has flown roughly 100 rescue missions in less than a week as floods and mudslides devastate the country.

nri-world.excerpt: Retired Air Marshal Jeetendra Mishra, selected from over 5,500 applicants, takes charge of the Ram Janmabhoomi Trust as it seeks to restore credibility after a donations embezzlement scandal.
nri-world.image_caption: The Ram Temple in Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh. The Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust has appointed retired Air Marshal Jeetendra Mishra as its first CEO.
nri-world.nri_angle: Overseas donations were a significant part of the Ram Temple's construction fund, and the appointment of a professional CEO signals institutional accountability for the diaspora's contributions.

nri-world.title: Aditi Paudel, 17, Becomes Japan's First Literacy Ambassador
nri-world.excerpt: The Nepali-origin high school senior in Tokyo has been appointed by the World Literacy Foundation, becoming the first ambassador from Japan in the program's 12-year history.

nri-world.image_caption: Dr. Ajay Kela, CEO and Board Member of Wadhwani Foundation, leads the organization's mission to create 5 million jobs and upskill 25 million people across emerging economies.

food.title: That Silver Coating on Your Mithai May Be Aluminium, and Doctors Say It Can Harm Your Liver
food.excerpt: Cheap aluminium foil is increasingly being substituted for genuine silver leaf on Indian sweets, with health experts warning of risks to the liver, kidneys, and nervous system from accumulated heavy metals.
food.image_caption: Silver-coated Indian sweets. Regulators have found that some silver foil on mithai may actually be aluminium, which doctors warn can harm the liver.
food.nri_angle: NRIs sending or receiving Indian sweets during festivals should be aware of aluminium-adulteration risks in silver leaf, particularly when buying from unverified sources.

carousel.title: CLARITY Act Explained: What the US Crypto Bill Means for Indian Investors
